description: Publishers and program names the startup manager recognises, so an ordinary updater does not look like a mystery. Community-editable: add an entry rather than teaching users to ignore warnings.
notes: This file lives in rules/startup/ rather than rules/ because it is not a cleaner rule pack — it has no paths, no globs and no action. The cleaner's loader reads rules/*.json and would refuse to start the app on a file it cannot compile.
`verdict` is a hint the UI shows, never something that acts on its own. `keep` greys the toggle only when `os` is also true; otherwise it is advice a person can overrule.
`impact` is an estimate and is labelled as one everywhere it appears.
